notes.title: Cheesy Update!
notes.content: [list][*][p]Two new cheese coins worth 2x and 4x the standard coin value[/p][/*][*][p]New double-jumping rat character, Eugene[/p][/*][*][p]Improved sprites for flying enemies in each location[/p][/*][*][p]New obstacle layouts for the highest-speed difficulty[/p][/*][*][p]If your rat is pushed back by an obstacle, it will now slowly return to its starting point when on the ground[/p][/*][*][p]Minor hitbox fixes for improved collision detection[/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: Two new cheese coins worth 2x and 4x the standard coin value
Improved sprites for flying enemies in each location
New obstacle layouts for the highest-speed difficulty
If your rat is pushed back by an obstacle, it will now slowly return to its starting point when on the ground
